import 'package:xberg/xberg.dart';

  await RustLib.init();
  try {
    final inputs = await Future.wait((jsonDecode(r'[{"bytes":"pdf/fake_memo.pdf","config":{"output_format":"markdown"},"filename":"fake_memo.pdf","kind":"bytes"}]') as List<dynamic>).cast<Map<String, dynamic>>().map((m) => createExtractInputFromJson(json: jsonEncode(m))));
    final result = await XbergBridge.extractBatch(inputs);
    stdout.writeln(result.results[0].mimeType);
    stdout.writeln(result.results[0].content);
    stdout.writeln(result.results[0].metadata.outputFormat);
  } finally {
    RustLib.dispose();
